The workbook generation failed because expected calculated values in the 'Task' sheet were missing (None) instead of containing the required numerical results.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells H12 through L17 (top block) and H35 through L40 (net metric) returned None instead of the expected float values (e.g., H12 expected 612.5, H35 expected 4.499). This indicates the logic for populating these specific matrix ranges in the 'Task' worksheet is either missing or failing to execute.
